storyline:
0.0s: A cat and a boy in a yellow shirt sit at a table covered with a white cloth, surrounded by various household items like pots and pans.

50.8s: A boy in a yellow shirt stands near a window with stairs behind him, while a cat looks out from the same window.

101.7s: The boy in a yellow shirt stands next to a staircase with a textured railing; a cat is perched on the upper steps.

152.6s: A girl with red hair and glasses dressed as a woman stands confidently, gesturing dramatically while holding what appears to be a hat in her hands.

203.5s: The girl in costume looks surprised as the man in green sits nearby; they are seated on a couch together with various objects around them.

254.4s: A man in a brown coat stands at a counter holding something, while a cat and other animals look on from behind the counter.

305.2s: A small wooden house with blue windows features a sign above it reading 'Дом свободный, живите кто хотите,' which translates to 'Free House, live whoever you want.'

356.1s: A gray cat stands on its hind legs indoors, one hand raised as if waving or signaling, inside a room with visible patterns on the walls.

407.0s: Two anthropomorphic animals—a brown dog and a gray cat—sit at a wooden table in a rustic room decorated with kitchen utensils hanging above them.

457.9s: A man in a brown coat walks along a wooden path while a small cat follows closely behind him, carrying what seems like a book or paper.

508.8s: Inside a dark outdoor setting, two anthropomorphic animals—a brown dog and a gray cat—sit together on a log-like structure against a starry sky background.

559.6s: In an exterior night scene, three characters—a man in a trench coat pulling a suitcase, the boy in yellow, and two animals—stand near each other outside a house.

610.5s: An interior shot shows a man wearing a green sweater standing at a counter in a kitchen with various utensils hanging above the sink area.

661.4s: Two animals—a brown dog and a gray cat—sit on a bench inside a wooden room with pink curtains over the windows behind them.

712.3s: An exterior view of a rustic building shows a man in a brown coat walking away from it while holding what looks like an open newspaper or magazine.

763.2s: A gray cat stands holding a wooden pole upright, looking excitedly upward inside a simple wooden room with minimal furnishings.

814.0s: Inside a rustic house, the woman reads from a piece of paper while another character peeks through partially drawn curtains behind her.

864.9s: A man and woman sit on a green couch; he holds onto her arm reassuringly while she gazes upward, seemingly surprised or concerned about something above them.

915.8s: A gray cat in striped clothing stands near the center of a room, gazing through a doorway into another part of the house where various objects are visible.

966.6s: Inside a cozy rustic room, three characters—a woman sitting on a bed, the boy in yellow, and the man in brown—interact while dressed casually for home.

1017.5s: The woman stands outdoors near bushes in front of a car, wearing glasses and pointing her finger thoughtfully toward someone or something off-camera beside her.

1068.4s: A blue title card displays credits: 'АВТОР СЦЕНАРИЯ Э.УСПЕНСКИЙ', 'РЕЖИССЕР В.ПОПОВ' written in bold white letters against a bright blue sky backdrop.

1119.3s: Inside a rustic wooden room, two characters—the brown dog and the gray cat—sit at a table covered with red-and-white checkered tablecloth while holding tea sets.

1170.2s: In another rustic interior setting, various furniture including a wardrobe, chairs, and windows adorned with floral decorations surround the characters in this room.

1221.0s: Inside a rustic wooden room featuring a window with checkered curtains overlooking greenery outside, the gray cat sits at a sewing machine while working diligently.

1271.9s: Two characters—a man carrying luggage and the girl in blue—walk along what appears to be a train platform as they head toward an exit door.

1322.8s: Outside under a large tree, a man pushes a cart pulled by two donkeys across grassy terrain while the gray cat observes nearby from its perch.

1373.7s: In an outdoor scene with tall grass and bushes, the brown dog stands holding onto a stick, while the gray cat lies relaxed on the ground beside it.

1424.6s: A close-up of a colorful striped chair back suggests someone lounging in it against a calm blue background representing water or sky.

1475.4s: Inside a dark barn-like room, the brown dog and gray cat stand side by side, gazing up at something unseen above them while conversing.

1526.3s: Outside in front of a small wooden house, a white cow stands calmly next to the gray cat as an elderly woman approaches holding what looks like food.

1577.2s: The brown dog stands outside a rustic house with light blue shutters; it holds up a yellow envelope-like object while facing another person nearby.

1628.0s: Inside a barn or stable, the brown dog and gray cat walk side by side as the elderly woman sits cross-legged holding a cardboard box in front of her face.

1678.9s: In an outdoor grassy setting, the man in brown carries a large yellow box while walking briskly past another character standing still.

1729.8s: Outside a wooden building, three characters—the brown dog, the gray cat, and the elderly woman—gather around while holding cups and engaging in conversation together.

1780.7s: Through a windowpane, a gray cat wearing red clothing appears joyful or excited indoors while another character outside holds what seems like a mobile device up to their ear.

1831.6s: Outside in grassy surroundings, the man wears a blue outfit and runs joyfully across the ground toward something off-screen that catches his attention enthusiastically.

1882.4s: The girl sits on the ground beside the brown dog as both look upward intently at something happening above them in the sky.

1933.3s: A rustic building shows a gray cat peeking out from behind one of its many windows, adding character to this quaint scene filled with natural elements.

1984.2s: The man stands holding his briefcase close while making eye contact with someone else who gestures back at him expressively during their interaction outdoors.

2035.1s: The girl walks past the brown dog and gray cat on a path outside a rustic building; she pulls her sleeve over her face humorously while holding luggage.

2086.0s: Outside near a rustic building, the man stands beside the brown dog as he examines something inside the dog's mouth with curiosity or surprise.

2136.8s: The man stands in an open space holding up a yellow box in front of his face, partially obscuring himself from view while another person looks on nearby.

2187.7s: A title card displays 'ВСЕ САМЫЕ ЛЮБИМЫЕ МУЛЬТИКИ ИЗ ДЕТСТВА НА КАНАЛЕ' meaning 'All Our Favorite Classics from Childhood on Channel,' set against a clear blue sky.

2238.6s: Inside a rustic room with patchwork patterns decorating the walls, the man stands near a window while seated characters hold pens and engage in drawing activities together.

2289.5s: The man stands confidently in front of what seems to be an audience inside a rustic room decorated with patchwork designs while gesturing enthusiastically toward them.

2340.4s: A snowy outdoor scene shows the gray cat in winter attire standing alongside another character dressed warmly as they approach someone holding up an object for examination.

2391.2s: In a cozy winter setting, several characters gather around watching something unfold before them; the atmosphere feels intimate yet festive given their attire and expressions.

2442.1s: Inside a well-decorated room featuring vibrant flowers and plants, the man stands holding his coat closed while smiling warmly toward someone nearby inside the space.

2493.0s: The man claps his hands together excitedly inside a brightly colored room adorned with orange wallpaper featuring vertical stripes complemented by hanging lamps.

2543.8s: Inside another section of the same house, the man examines something intently on top of a green surface while seated beside various household items including books and appliances.

2594.7s: In a dimly lit room with bookshelves and vintage decor, two characters—the man in brown and the gray cat—engage in conversation near a table laden with papers.

2645.6s: Outside at night, two characters—one appearing to be a child wearing pajamas, the other dressed formally as a man—interact near steps leading up to a house entrance.

2696.5s: Inside a rustic wooden room with warm lighting provided by candlelight from multiple sources scattered throughout; two characters converse seated near small tables.

2747.4s: Outside under heavy snowfall conditions, a white signpost points toward 'ПРОСТОКВАШИНО 500м' indicating distance to Proktoposhino village amidst wintry scenery.

2798.2s: A close-up reveals an intense fire burning brightly within a stone fireplace structure; flames flicker vigorously against dark interior surroundings illuminated by glow.

2849.1s: Inside a rustic wooden room with colorful patchwork walls, the man stands near an old radio emitting static noise while conversing animatedly with another character present nearby.

2900.0s: The man sits beside the gray cat who holds a guitar; both wear scarves and appear engaged in musical performance or practice session indoors.

2950.9s: Inside a snowy room, the girl wears a brown coat over her clothes while standing beside someone else dressed similarly for cold weather protection.

3001.8s: Outside in snow-covered surroundings, multiple characters—including children bundled up warmly—gather near a doorway while observing something happening outside actively involving them all.

3052.6s: A title card presents information about Soviet-era animated content categorized into sections labeled 'МУЛЬТИКИ ДЛЯ МАЛЫШЕЙ' (Cartoons for Children) and other segments.

3103.5s: Continuing the previous frame, additional categories such as 'МУЛЬТИКИ ДЕТСКОЙ ПОСТАРШЕ' (Classics for Older Kids), 'МНОГОГРАДНЫЕ МУЛЬТИКИ' (Multisegment Cartoons), and 'САМЫЕ ИЗВЕСТНЫЕ МУЛЬТИКИ' (Most Famous Cartoons) are introduced.

3154.4s: The final portion reiterates the organization of animated series into various thematic groups emphasizing variety within Soviet animation production history.

3205.3s: Final credits appear listing composer E.Krivchatov, song text author Y.V.Zhukova & V.I.Tabakov & others credited with voice acting roles played collectively by ensemble cast members contributing to overall soundtrack quality.
